_Generated 2026-07-25 by /mol:map (post scf-review chain 01–08 + MetalWalls waves)._

## Inventory (backend-pillars)

Catalog of `include/atomiverse/` (mirrored impl under `src/`) as of **2026-07-25**, after the **scf-review** chain (01–08, `f9a6443a..8db7eab9`) and the **MetalWalls capability-loop** waves 1–4 (wave 4 partly uncommitted in the working tree). Top level is `core/` + `cpu/` + `cuda/` + `torch/` (experimental) + `molrs.hpp`. **No `facade/`**, **no top-level `longrange/` or `potentials/`** — reciprocal-space and pair math are backend-owned. Backend roots hold **directories only** (full English words, mirrored across `cpu/`/`cuda/`; a CPU-only domain is simply absent on CUDA). Namespaces are **not yet** directory-aligned (`ATV::cpu::md::MD` still lives under `cpu/dynamics/`, `cpu/multiscale/` types are plain `ATV::cpu::…`, phase enums under `ATV::md` etc.). CUDA configures/builds/links on GH200; its classical-MD force path is the OpenMM cluster/tile engine.

Deltas since the 2026-07-23 blueprint: **two module dirs added to the catalog** (`cpu/electrodes/`, `cpu/multiscale/` — both tracked, both CPU-only), `cpu/linalg/` widened (`sym_power`, `eig_nonsymmetric`, new `linear_solve.h`), `cpu/scf/internal/` grew six dedup/engine headers plus an 11-file `.cpp` relocation, and **three new architecture scrubs** are ctest-registered.

### Style summary

- **Naming:** `ATV::` root; backends `cpu` / `cuda` / `torch`; domains often still use short namespaces (`md`, `minimizer`, `sampling`, `path`, `scf`, `pw`, `vib`, `evaluate`, `electrodes`) while **directories** are full words (`dynamics/`, `montecarlo/`, `planewave/`, …); `cpu/multiscale/` types sit in plain `ATV::cpu`. File extensions: CPU `.h`/`.cpp`, CUDA `.cuh`/`.cu` (documented CUDA-free bridges keep `.h`: `log_callback.h`, `timer.h`, `pair_kernel.h`). Internals under `internal/` — **and their `.cpp` files now live under `src/<domain>/internal/` too** (scf-review-05).
- **Construction:** OOP constructors and member parameters — **no public `make_*` / `build_*` / `*_config()` factories** (grep-gated; the whitelist shrank again with `build_molecular_grid`'s deletion, leaving 4 scoped exemptions in `cpu/scf`). Lookup tables are constructors (`GthPotential(Element, name)`, `MolecularGrid(atoms, natm, level, …)`, EAM/SW rows) and **throw** on unsupported input. Ownership at registration: `add(rvalue)` owns, `add_ref(lvalue)` borrows.
- **Driver model:** a Driver is a **staged loop + Criterion termination + optional OutcomePolicy**; presets attach defaults in constructors. Nesting via `DriverNode` / `run_nested` on one shared `Runtime` (inner status isolated). Algorithms publish metrics; **only Criterion declares convergence**.
- **Phase typing:** only `ATV::slot_of` / `ctx.at(phase)` / `make_binding` — no hand-written phase→int casts (scrubbed).
- **Frame purity:** sole I/O currency is `blocks + meta + simbox` on CPU; method scratch (integrals, DIIS/CC amplitudes, AO maps, grids, AO-on-grid caches) is **private to the method**, never on Frame. Neighbor lists published as non-owning `ctx.md.pair_list`.
- **Component model:** Role bitset (`FrameImmutable` / `Deferred` / `ExternalIO`); kinds for preset validation; opt-in protocols. Lifecycle `build → launch×N → destroy` (no alloc in `launch`).
- **Dual-backend:** same directory vocabulary; CUDA Frame is device-pointer SoA; precision tiers map 1:1 (`StorageReal`↔`real_t`, …); kind bases mirrored on CUDA.
- **Errors:** throw on contract breaks (schema materialize, unsupported basis/PP name, cross-workflow misbind, missing kinds, non-converged `solve_pcg`). **Never `std::abort` in library numerics — always a typed exception**, including in code ported from C references (`rys_roots` was the last abort site). No fallback values in lookup tables.
- **Constants:** π is single-sourced as `units::pi` — no local `kPi` / `PI` / `M_PI` (prose rule; no grep gate yet).
- **Dedup discipline:** shared skeletons live in exactly one place and are **grep-gated, not prose** — `internal/eom_ccsd_common.h` for new EOM sectors, `internal/ci_engine.h` for determinant-CI methods (`h(p,q)`, chemist `g=(pq|rs)`), `MeanFieldMethod::central_difference_nuclear_hessian` for mean-field FD Hessians, `linalg/` for shared dense math.
- **Tests / witnesses:** `tests/` unit-only (mirrors source dirs, incl. `tests/cpu/electrodes/`, `tests/cpu/multiscale/`); `regressions/<domain>/<case>/` is the only e2e home and is **public-API-only** — a dual-path parity witness gets a minimal **public member** rather than an `internal/` include (precedent: `bool RHF::cc_diis`). A feature landing must update its "unsupported-path" `EXPECT_THROW` guards in the same change.
- **Units:** public eV/Å/fs; SCF/PW/GPW internals Hartree/Ry, energy written eV to `frame.meta[kEnergy]`; electrode surfaces use V for Ψ and e for Q.

### Layer roles

| Module | Role (Architecture vocabulary) |
|---|---|
| `core/` | CUDA-free **contract layer** — precision, schema, Driver template, Plan/Stage/Role/Verdict, device tags |
| `molrs.hpp` | External **FFI boundary** (molrs exchange) |
| `cpu/frame/`, `cuda/frame/`, `torch/frame/` | **Frame pillar** — device-resident state + residency ops / transfer |
| `cpu/driver/`, `cuda/driver/` | **Driver pillar** — loop node, Runtime/Backend coordinator, criteria, outcome |
| `cpu/component/`, `cuda/component/`, `torch/component/` | **Component pillar** — base, kinds, Context, protocols |
| `cpu/device/`, `cuda/device/`, `torch/device/` | **Infra — device** (threads/streams/timing) |
| `cpu/communication/`, `cuda/communication/` | **Infra — communication** (DD, halo, migration, multi-GPU) |
| `cpu/asynchronous/`, `cuda/asynchronous/` | **Infra — async analysis** (snapshot ring / AsyncBridge) |
| `cpu/neighbor/`, `cuda/neighbor/`, `torch/neighbor/` | **Infra — neighbor** structures + published PairList (CUDA: OpenMM cluster CSR) |
| `cpu/linalg/` | **Infra — dense linear algebra** (CPU): eigensolve / matrix power / density / PCG |
| `cpu/replica/` | **Infra — replica expansion** (one Frame → N coupled replicas) |
| `cpu/task/` | **Infra / app bridge** — serializable task protocol for launcher |
| `cpu/electrodes/` | **Infra — electrode charge machinery** (CPU): ASPC charge history + charging-work `Potential`; consumed by `cpu/dynamics/` constant-potential components |
| `cpu/evaluate/`, `cuda/evaluate/` | **Domain — Evaluate** preset |
| `cpu/dynamics/`, `cuda/dynamics/` | **Domain — MD** (CPU also hosts the constant-potential / finite-field electrode components) |
| `cpu/montecarlo/` | **Domain — Monte Carlo** (CPU) |
| `cpu/minimize/`, `cuda/minimize/` | **Domain — geometry + cell optimization** |
| `cpu/path/` | **Domain — path / NEB / REMD / PIMD / dimer / IRC / string** (CPU) |
| `cpu/vibration/` | **Domain — vibrational response + phonons** (CPU) |
| `cpu/scf/`, `cuda/scf/` | **Domain — Gaussian SCF + post-HF** (CPU methods = Driver; CUDA still bag solver) |
| `cpu/semiempirical/` | **Domain — NDDO/AM1/DFTB/xTB** (CPU) |
| `cpu/planewave/`, `cuda/planewave/` | **Domain — plane-wave DFT** (CPU adds bands/DOS) |
| `cpu/gpw/` | **Domain — GPW DFT** (CPU) |
| `cpu/multiscale/` | **Domain — QM/MM embedding** (CPU): mechanical / electrostatic / polarizable, all `Potential`-kind |
| `cpu/xc/` | **Domain — shared XC pieces** (CPU) |
| `cpu/longrange/`, `cuda/longrange/` | **Domain — reciprocal electrostatics** (backend-owned math; CPU adds slab correction) |
| `cpu/potentials/`, `cuda/potentials/`, `torch/potentials/` | **Domain — real-space force fields** |
| `cpu/bias/` | **Domain — bias / CV / metadynamics** (CPU) |
| `cpu/observe/`, `cuda/observe/` | **Domain — derived quantities** (Observer) |
| `cpu/record/`, `cuda/record/` | **Domain — I/O recorders** |
| `cpu/io/` | **I/O / molrs bridge** (CPU only) |
| `torch/*` | **Experimental** autograd backend skeleton |

### Architecture gates

Grep/CMake gates that pin the pillar layout (all ctest-registered; **18 shell gates**, +3 CMake modules):

**`tests/architecture/` (12 shell + 3 cmake)**
- `no_factory_scrub.sh` — ban public `make_*` / `build_*` / `*_config()` factories + intermediate types in `examples/`/`app/`; `cpu/scf`-scoped `build_*` wildcard with a 4-entry exemption whitelist (**`build_molecular_grid` removed 2026-07-24** — the grid is a lookup ctor now)
- `no_ao2mo_public_scrub.sh` — **new**: `ao2mo_ovov`/`ao2mo_full`/`mo_hcore` off public `mp2.h` and present in `internal/ao2mo.h`; no local `struct SO` / `so_eri` / `spat_`/`spin_`/`phys_`/`antisym_` copies in `src/cpu/scf`
- `posthf_dedup_scrub.sh` — **new**: `internal/eom_ccsd_common.h` + `internal/ci_engine.h` exist with their anchor symbols; **no free `build_imds` anywhere**; `make_tau`/`EomImds` and the determinant-CI machinery defined in exactly one place
- `scf_dedup_scrub.sh` — **new**: FD nuclear-Hessian sentinels gone from `rks/uks/rohf` hessian bodies (hoisted template owns them); no `make_result` / `make_force_result` under `src/cpu/scf` (tag ctor instead)
- `no_toplevel_shared_math_scrub.sh` — no top-level `longrange`/`potentials`; no `cuda/kspace`
- `path_words_scrub.sh` — full-word mirrored backend dirs (no `comm`/`async`/`md`/… abbreviations)
- `driver_names_scrub.sh` — `Driver`/`DriverNode`; no `CPUDriver`/`CUDADriver`/`LoopHandler`
- `no_backend_scrub.sh` — CPU `Backend` dissolved into Domain/Device/Analysis runtimes
- `layout_mirror_scrub.sh` — no `runtime/`/`loop/`/`shared/` dirs; `cuda/* ⊆ cpu/*` vocabulary; tests mirror source dirs
- `docs_vocab_scrub.sh` — docs free of legacy vocabulary
- `cuda_no_stale_api_scrub.sh` — ban bare `Real`, old unit constants, host-Frame accessor shapes in cuda trees
- `cuda_openmm_md_scrub.sh` — CUDA MD force path is OpenMM cluster/tile only; no `NonbondedStyle` dual architecture, no default `vl_*` force source
- `module_dag_auto_enable.cmake` / `module_off_excludes_sources.cmake` / `molrs_contract_mismatch.cmake` — module enablement + molrs pin

**`tests/core/`**
- `no_facade_scrub.sh` — `facade/` gone; contracts under `core/`
- `stage_typing_scrub.sh` — only `slot_of` may cast Phase enums

**`tests/cpu/` + `tests/cuda/`**
- `cpu/compatibility_surface_scrub.sh` — no compatibility aliases / forwarding accessors / legacy decoders on the CPU hard-cut surface; **grid guard refreshed to the ctor shape** (fails if `MolecularGrid(..., int natm` is not followed by an explicit `GridLevel`)
- `cpu/frame/direct_access_scrub.sh`, `cpu/frame/field_list_scrub.sh` — Frame span/meta access + field-list discipline
- `cuda/observe/rdf_molrs_migration.sh` — RDF binning/normalization stays molrs-only on both backends

Backend-mirror also ships out-of-library consumers under `regressions/layout/` and `regressions/architecture/`. (Note for map consumers: the CUDA SCF-solver-isolation and `scf_phase_scrub` gates named in AGENTS.md are **not** present as scripts in the current tree — the only `tests/cuda/` shell gate is `rdf_molrs_migration.sh`.)
